# Governing asset selection v1
# GLOB expands matching files recursively; FILE is an explicit expected file; DIR expands all files.
# {BRAIN} = الجذر القانوني (مجلد brain). لا تُكتب مسارات أرشيفية هنا.
# __pycache__ and *.pyc are excluded because they are generated bytecode, not governing source assets.
GLOB /home/ubuntu/skills/*/SKILL.md
GLOB /home/ubuntu/skills/*/references/**
GLOB /home/ubuntu/skills/*/scripts/**
FILE {BRAIN}/INDEX.md
FILE {BRAIN}/runbook/runbook.json
DIR {BRAIN}/sections
DIR {BRAIN}/validators
FILE {BRAIN}/appendices/threat-scale.json
FILE {BRAIN}/appendices/zone-registry.json
EXCLUDE **/__pycache__/**
EXCLUDE **/*.pyc
FILE {BRAIN}/audit/asset-floor.json
DIR {BRAIN}/tools
DIR {BRAIN}/tests
